scores.evidence: Both mermaid figures (s1-diagram, s3-diagram) use flowchart TD and stay readable at 390 px with Japanese labels and captions, and the code blocks wrap cleanly with hanging indents. One exam option pair (e1) wraps its path chips mid-name on mobile, which makes the key comparison harder to read.

metrics.json reports no text-only screens on desktop-jp or mobile-jp, and the desktop median is 39 chars per line (target 30–40). Every section mixes in a definition table, figure, code, steps or a check, with no long walls of text.

The lesson is Japanese-only. All visible text, diagram labels, captions and controls are in Japanese, with English terms in parentheses on first use (スキル（skill）, サブエージェント（subagent）). Contrast is good and the steps and the predict and quiz buttons are not hidden under the top bar (56 px) or bottom bar (60 px) on any mobile screen.

mustFix.issue: Exam question e1, options b and a: at 390 px the chips `~/.claude/skills/api-guide/SKILL.md` and `.claude/skills/api-guide/SKILL.md` are longer than the option line, so each wraps inside its box after 'api-' ('api-' / 'guide/SKILL.md'). The question asks the learner to compare these paths with option d `.claude/skills/api-guide.md`, which fits on one line. The split skill name makes it hard to see that the three paths differ only in the prefix and the ending.
mustFix.fix: Give the e1 options a shorter skill name so each path fits on one mobile line. For example, use `api` instead of `api-guide`: `~/.claude/skills/api/SKILL.md`, `.claude/skills/api/SKILL.md`, `.claude/skills/api.md`. Change the matching feedback text the same way.

niceToHave: practice (section title): on mobile the heading '演習：自分の手順をスキルにし、調べものを任せる' breaks as 'スキルに' / 'し、調べものを任せる', splitting 'にし'. A slightly shorter title such as '演習：手順をスキルにし、調べものを任せる' or '演習：スキルを作り、調べものを任せる' would break more naturally (pages/mobile-jp-18.png).

s2-skill: on mobile, source line 12 '1. `git status` と `git diff HEAD` で、' soft-wraps so that 'で、' sits alone on a visual line before line 13. It is readable, but splitting it in the source after 'HEAD`' would avoid the orphan (pages/mobile-jp-06.png).
reader: the mobile full-length PNG stops at 16000px (pageHeight 22348) and 14 failed /api/ requests were logged. These are environment and reader limits; the per-screen PNGs cover the whole lesson.
reader: desktop-jp-21.png shows '3% 完了' while desktop-jp-22.png and mobile-jp-31.png show '0% 完了'. The progress counter changes between capture passes, which is not a lesson issue.
summary: I checked the per-screen PNGs for the lesson at lessonHash sha256:a3c0929a6fa09460. metrics.json shows no hard failures (no horizontal overflow, console, mermaid, unknown-block or image errors) and no personal data appears on any screen. The layout is strong: both TD flowcharts, the definition tables and the wrapped YAML code blocks read well at 390 px. The one must-fix is exam question e1: on mobile the long `api-guide/SKILL.md` paths wrap mid-name, so use a shorter skill name to keep the path comparison on one line.
